attributes.name: environment_groups
attributes.parameters: [{"name": "d", "type": "Directory"}, {"name": "spec", "type": "str", "description": "cloud/env"}, {"name": "resources", "type": "tuple[Resource]"}, {"name": "summarize", "type": "tuple[str]", "required": false, "description": "kinds counted, not listed, when new and role-less"}]
attributes.purpose: ((DN, (entry, ...)), ...) and notices placing the resources a cloud reports into an environment's servers and bindings. Each resource is matched per its import kind (provider ref, name, attribute, function; servers also by hostname or private address). Failing that (5.5c), a resource matched by ref that names a role realizes the record's one designed binding of its kind for that role: no ciamProviderRef yet, not claimed by an earlier resource. The first read after applying a design records the ref instead of adding a copy. New resources are added only when they name a role; the rest are named. Inherited entries are left to the base. Links are resolved as DNs or roles; kinds in summarize are counted. A group of an entry the record holds keeps what the record holds beneath it unchanged (another importer's entries: a managed identity service's sign-in flows), so a cloud read never deletes them.

attributes.name: check_boundary
attributes.purpose: Azure adapter planner check: the target's services outside its authorization's in-scope list, a service Microsoft documents as covered by a listed one (COVERED: External ID by Microsoft Entra ID) in place when that one is listed

attributes.name: required_providers
attributes.purpose: The terraform block of an Azure root: azurerm (~> 5.9); azapi (~> 2.13) when the root renders azapi resources (an external tenant included); azuread (~> 3.10, validated against 3.10.0) when it renders Microsoft Entra ID policy (risk-based Conditional Access, 5.5e) or an external tenant's app registrations (task 547).

attributes.name: terraform_parts
attributes.purpose: (parts, landing_dns, interconnect lines, scripts, container files) of environment m's Azure Terraform before it is placed: the stack's providers (azapi also for an external tenant, azuread also for its app registrations, each External ID target's aliased azuread provider) and main items (network, servers, groups, backups, services, databases, object stores, DNS, trails, workspaces, log collection, container logs, alerts, Sentinel onboarding and analytics rules: render_sentinel, web tests, check jobs, security, discovery, Purview, suppressions, budgets, quota requests, Key Vault secrets, and last the Entra External ID targets: render_external_id) and the landing zone's and plumbing keepers' parts.
attributes.returns: {"type": "tuple", "description": "(parts, landing_dns, interconnect header lines, check scripts {path: text}, container files {path: text})"}

attributes.name: _target
attributes.purpose: Findings for a binding running one of the platform's identity services on a managed service: availability, per-integration and service gaps, hosts, MFA split, claim transforms (an action when the service can't express them or does only on a condition, e.g. an extension), partition notes, users, and its ok line.

attributes.name: partition
attributes.purpose: The Azure cloud environment m's cloud is in: usgovernment (Azure Government), else public (the ManagedService partition of External ID).

attributes.name: external_id_bindings
attributes.purpose: Environment m's Entra External ID bindings (ciamManagedIdentity with ciamManagedService entra-external-id).

attributes.name: external_id_notes
attributes.purpose: The render notes of environment m's Entra External ID bindings: each target's (the tenant to create by hand or through a preview API, its app registrations waiting on the tenant ID, its client credentials, its user flows/upstream providers/extensions: actions) and a neighbour's (not the platform's to render: a note).

attributes.name: _neighbour_note
attributes.purpose: The note of an External ID neighbour binding: a neighbour the platform federates with, kept by its keeper, not rendered.

attributes.name: tenant_name
attributes.purpose: The initial subdomain of a binding's external tenant (its ARM resource name): the label of its *.ciamlogin.com sign-in host (ciamFqdn), else its name's letters and digits (at most 26).

attributes.name: renders_tenant
attributes.purpose: Whether environment m's render writes an external tenant through azapi (the cloud allows the azapi add-on and it has an External ID target in a public cloud).

attributes.name: renders_applications
attributes.purpose: Whether environment m's render writes app registrations through azuread: an External ID target whose tenant ID (ciamProviderRef) is recorded.

attributes.name: custom_scopes
attributes.purpose: The scopes the oidc-client integrations an External ID target serves ask for beyond OIDC's (openid, profile, email, offline_access), each once: its identity service's API scopes.

attributes.name: scope_id
attributes.purpose: The stable id of an identity service's API scope: a UUID5 of its base URL and the scope's name, so re-renders keep the oauth2_permission_scope id.

attributes.name: confidential
attributes.purpose: Whether an oidc-client integration authenticates at the token endpoint (a token auth method other than none, or none recorded): a web client with a credential to give it.

attributes.name: hostless
attributes.purpose: Whether a redirect URI has no host (com.example.app:/cb, RFC 8252's private-use form), which azuread refuses: left out of the render with a comment.

attributes.name: external_id_providers
attributes.purpose: The aliased azuread provider block (alias the binding's name, tenant_id its ciamProviderRef) of each External ID target whose tenant ID is recorded, for providers.tf (placement drops it from roots that don't use it).

attributes.name: render_external_id
attributes.purpose: HCL for environment m's External ID targets, each stamped with its entry: its notes as comments, the tenant (azapi ciamDirectories@2023-05-17-preview, inputs, import block once its tenant ID is recorded) where the azapi add-on is allowed, its identity service's API application, an application + service principal per oidc-client and per saml2-sp integration (custom template, SAML mode, token signing certificate); a neighbour's note as its comment.

attributes.name: output_kind
attributes.purpose: The projection a Graph output file is kept by: its read's name (pages <name>-<n> by their read), a flow's includeApplications output (flow-<id>-applications) by flow-applications.

attributes.name: project
attributes.purpose: A Graph list output ({value: [...], @odata.nextLink}) kept to the allowlist of its kind (PROJECTIONS): only the fields the importer reads (never passwordCredentials, keyCredentials, identity providers' client secrets, extensions' endpoints), and the next page's link.

attributes.name: project_output
attributes.purpose: Command.keep of a Graph read: its output text kept to the allowlist (project), as JSON text, before anything else sees it (export, evidence hash, --save); an output that isn't JSON keeps nothing.

attributes.name: graph_target
attributes.purpose: Environment m's Entra External ID targets whose tenant ID (ciamProviderRef) is recorded: what the external-id collector reads.

attributes.name: graph_problems
attributes.purpose: Collector.problems of external-id: why environment m's external tenant can't be collected (no target records its tenant ID, or more than one: one login reads one tenant), else None.

attributes.name: graph_steps
attributes.parameters: [{"name": "d", "type": "Directory", "required": true}, {"name": "m", "type": "EnvModel", "required": true}, {"name": "done", "type": "dict", "required": true, "description": "{path: output} collected so far"}, {"name": "options", "type": "dict", "required": true}]
attributes.purpose: Collector.steps of external-id: the az rest GETs against Graph v1.0 still to make (organization, applications, servicePrincipals, identityProviders with $select; authenticationEventsFlows and customAuthenticationExtensions projected), every page each output names next (@odata.nextLink), then each flow's includeApplications; each Command keeps its output to the allowlist; nothing read twice.

attributes.name: tenant_check
attributes.purpose: Collector.verify of external-id: az account show, and whether its tenantId is the external tenant environment m's target records (ciamProviderRef) and its environmentName AzureCloud (external tenants exist in public clouds only).

attributes.name: read_graph
attributes.purpose: Importer azure/external-id: each <cloud>/<env>/external-id/ folder's Graph outputs read into the environment's External ID target whose tenant ID organization.json names: applications + service principals as the realized identity service's integrations (saml2-sp in SAML mode, else oidc-client; matched by client ID, entity ID, then name; a name match keeps the record's differing client ID with a notice; new ones served by the service; Microsoft's own skipped), authentication events flows as ciamSignInFlow and custom authentication extensions as ciamAuthExtension beneath the binding (made exactly the tenant's), identity providers named in a notice; values looking like secret material withheld.

attributes.description: Milestone 111's External ID slice (deferred note 3100 on file 1042, connectors/managed_identity.py; flow 66). (1) Render a target's app registrations into the external tenant (hashicorp/azuread current release: azuread_application / azuread_service_principal through a provider alias with tenant_id = ciamProviderRef; SAML apps via the service principal's preferred_single_sign_on_mode) and the tenant itself (ARM Microsoft.AzureActiveDirectory/ciamDirectories through azapi; verify the type and API version against the local bicep type index first). (2) A read-only importer of the tenant's Graph configuration (applications, servicePrincipals, identity/authenticationEventsFlows, identity/identityProviders, identity/customAuthenticationExtensions; app-only *.Read.All permissions), allowlist projection with no credential fields, plus its collector. (3) Research to move External ID and Cognito capabilities left 'not established' to supported/unsupported with sources, and confirm 'Microsoft Entra External ID' as the Azure FedRAMP scope page's name (showcase B76). Managed directories and Google Identity Platform stay for later tasks. Design to the master before coding (it may change what the record holds).
